description: Opens the Bandmixr studio in the chat to master or enhance a finished song (a stereo mix). The song is checked in the browser for loudness, peaks, stereo image and tonal balance, and a 30-second mastered preview plays next to the original. Mastering the full song needs a Bandmixr account.

genre.description: Genre of the song. rock_indie = rock / indie; pop = pop; acoustic = acoustic, singer-songwriter; hip_hop_grime = hip hop, rap, trap, grime; electronic = electronic, EDM, house, techno; reggae_dub = reggae / dub; orchestral = orchestral, film score; metal = metal; jazz = jazz; blues = blues; funk_soul = funk / soul / R&B; punk = punk; other = anything else or not sure (balanced, genre-neutral).

preset.description: Mastering style. streaming = optimized for Spotify and Apple Music; optimal = balanced ("Standard"); loud = maximum punch and loudness.

name: master_song
title: Master a song
